svg.title: Commercial Model Reference Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-commercial-model-reference-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Commercial Model Reference Roadmap; subtitle: Source practices from Gautam Prachi ([ctFRKtUiETo @ 00:05:09]), Samik Choudhury ([xbFsXyB1UZo @ 00:01:41]), Frey Chu ([NoUJBS6-yNQ @ 00:12:47]), and Jaryd Krause - Buying Online Businesses ([O0q1EG7DNIc @ 00:06:44]).; chart type: timeline_roadmap; note: Week labels are the requested presentation slots, not speaker-reported deadlines or a transcript-backed four-week implementation schedule. The entries cover separate commercial models. Gautam Prachi ([ctFRKtUiETo @ 00:05:09]) supplies the 14-day trial duration; Contentbase ([3Fkd3FP40iU @ 00:02:49]) says the programmatic approach requires technical expertise and SEO understanding and is not a set-it-and-forget-it solution.; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Bound the Portfolio Trial; deliverable: A free SEO trial offered to only one prospect for 14 days to develop experience and a testimonial. [Gautam Prachi — ctFRKtUiETo @ 00:05:09]; gate: Keep the offer bounded to the speaker's one prospect and 14-day trial. [Gautam Prachi — ctFRKtUiETo @ 00:05:09]; week: Week 2; title: Connect Templates to Search Intent; deliverable: A reusable interface supplied with page-specific JSON or markdown for individual static pages. [Samik Choudhury — xbFsXyB1UZo @ 00:01:41]; gate: The product must solve the problem of the search query. [SaaS SEO Engine — kBXz_ArlMVk @ 00:03:49]; week: Week 3; title: Inspect Directory Records; deliverable: Directory records checked against the intended niche; scraped results can contain junk. [Frey Chu — NoUJBS6-yNQ @ 00:12:47]; gate: Do not treat returned directory data as automatically accurate. [Frey Chu — NoUJBS6-yNQ @ 00:12:47]; week: Week 4; title: Investigate Acquisition Evidence; deliverable: Independent purchase research alongside broker vetting. [Jaryd Krause - Buying Online Businesses — O0q1EG7DNIc @ 00:07:18]; gate: Investigate beyond the broker listing; the reported seller withheld a PBN. Retain extra capital to operate the acquired business. [Jaryd Krause - Buying Online Businesses — O0q1EG7DNIc @ 00:06:44] [Mike Swigunski — w5fG8eKka5Y @ 00:04:47]
